intro.title: Get started in 2 minutes

level.heading: What's your level?
level.sub: Choose the one that fits you best.

goal.heading: Why are you learning German?
goal.sub: So we can pick the right mentor and roadmap for you.

quickWin.wrong: Not quite — give it another go!
